description:
Fired when the Admin API is asked whether an add-on's own checks pass - the checks its validate command runs. Lets an add-on declare those checks, so that whether each passes can be read over the API without a shell on the server.

Only the outcome of each check is returned: ok, warn, fail or skipped. The rows a check returns are counted, and their labels and details are never sent. A check runs over the API only when it is marked api: it must be quick, stay within the forum, and write nothing. Every other check is reported as skipped.

Callback signature:

array &$validators

Arguments:

  1. array &$validators - Add an entry keyed by your add-on id, with:
    • class - a class in your add-on's namespace, constructed with \XF\App.
    • checks - your checks, in order, keyed by an id of lower-case letters, digits and underscores. Each has a label, the public method that runs it and returns a list of rows of [outcome, label, detail], where the outcome is ok, warn, fail or skip, and api set to true when it may run over the API.

Example:

$validators['Vendor/AddOn'] = [
    'class' => \Vendor\AddOn\Check\HealthCheck::class,
    'checks' => [
        'tables' => ['label' => 'Tables', 'method' => 'tables', 'api' => true],
        'remote' => ['label' => 'Remote service', 'method' => 'remote'],
    ],
];

Declare your own add-on only: a class outside its namespace is refused.
